 Advertisement Gusty winds continue for the Gulf Coast Sunday evening along with a brief shower
 Winds could gust as high as 30 mph for areas across Southwest Florida 
 Advertisement Updated: 6:48 PM EDT Oct 25, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Raphael Tavernier Meteorologist Gusty winds continue for the Gulf Coast Sunday evening along with a brief shower
 Winds could gust as high as 30 mph for areas across Southwest Florida 
 Updated: 6:48 PM EDT Oct 25, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Raphael Tavernier Meteorologist FORT MYERS, Fla. — A quick-moving shower is possible tonight accompanied by northeasterly winds. Winds will continue to gust up to 30 mph through the night, and a small craft advisory will remain in place for coastal waters through Wednesday.
 Winds will continue to be the most noticeable part of our weather story over the next several days. High pressure to our north and a developing area of disturbed weather will increase the pressure gradient, allowing for windy conditions for the start of the workweek.
 Advertisement Rain chances will range anywhere from 10-20% this week.
